Messages.Author: Allan G Lewis
Messages.Body:
On 3 Apr 1997 22:34:31 GMT, "Niklas Jansson och Åsa Johansson"
<niklas....@mbox301.swipnet.se> wrote:

>I have a question that might be silly for those who have played Jyhad for a
>while ...

They say that the silly question is the one you don't ask...

>1. Can you play action modifiers after the prey has denied to block ? Can
>you in that case play Bonding when you see that the bleed get through ?

Yes, you can. In fact, *don't* play (for example) a bleed modifier
(such as Bonding) until you are pretty sure that the action is going
to be successful. Especially if your prey declines to block (and they
can't change their minds after declining), you should then play your
+bleed modifiers.

>2. Does combat ends (majesty) mean that a press can´t be played ?

Again, yes. You can't press a combat that isn't. Imagine the "real
world" dynamics of the Majesty card. A vampire skilled in the
discipline of Presence puts on a virtuoso performance about the recent
combat activities of vampires threatening the Masquerade and her
hapless victim is enthralled by her presence and thusly slinks away in
shame. Someone who slinks away from a confrontation is not likely to
try and press a combat...

Have fun.
